commit.message: feat(session-replay): adds banner for session replay waitlist (#40797) This PR adds a banner to the logic page to show a banner with a link to join the waitlist for Session Replay. Note that we purposely don't show this to self-hosted users. I added a CSS style to hide the banner if the screen is so narrow that it wouldn't fit on one line.
